scope: Consumed Dev mechanism screening and conditional paired experiment only. It is not a held-out generalization, leaderboard, or SOTA estimate.
scientific_question: On projects where a strong Agent forms a complete deployment program that still fails EnvBench Official, can same-session feedback from a target-state-faithful complete-program replay cause a fresh strong Agent to repair more programs to Official Pass than a matched fresh Agent receiving typed-null feedback?

implementation.algorithmic_difference_from_free_agent: Only the values returned by submit_and_replay after the Agent submits a complete program. No live frontier, external constraint solver, package rule, checkpoint graph, cross-case memory, or Official feedback is added.

screening.ordered_positions: 19 through 42 inclusive, without reordering or replacement
screening.baseline: One fresh codex-cli-goal-aware-boundary-v6 strong-Agent A1 session per position, gpt-5.6-sol xhigh, followed by postepisode EnvBench Official on Spark.
screening.eligibility: A1 completes, emits an admissible complete bootstrap program, and the unchanged program receives a valid terminal Official semantic Fail.
not_eligible: failure before a complete candidate is formed
infrastructure-censored Official outcome after allowed unchanged retries
screening.stop_rule: Stop after the first six eligible failures in position order, or after position 42 if fewer than six are found.
screening.selection_blinding: No matched-v2 control or treatment session is run until the six-case cohort is fixed. Selection uses only A1 candidate formation and postepisode Official status, never treatment outcome or perceived repairability.
screening.prior_exposure: Every source identity is already consumed by weaker methods, but positions 19-42 had no strong-model trajectory in the Census83 audit and were not used in matched-v1. Results remain Dev-only.

screening_execution.host_assignment: Use the construction host preassigned in the existing Census83 schedule; Spark and AgentHub each run at most one generation session. All terminal Official evaluations run on Spark.
screening_execution.official_visibility: Official runs only after each A1 session ends and is never returned to that Agent.
screening_execution.retry_policy: Retry unchanged bytes only for recognized infrastructure censoring. A pre-Agent implementation or source failure may be rerun fresh and recorded. Never rerun a semantic outcome with a changed prompt or program.
screening_execution.resource_policy: Token, time, and cost are measured outcomes, not success thresholds. Existing safety caps remain unchanged.

conditional_pair_design.control: Fresh gpt-5.6-sol xhigh session with the matched submit_and_replay schema returning withheld status and typed-null target-state values.
conditional_pair_design.treatment: Fresh gpt-5.6-sol xhigh session with the identical schema executing each submitted complete program through the EnvBench candidate path and returning public target-state feedback before the same session ends.
conditional_pair_design.execution_host: Both arms, all replays, and all postepisode Official evaluations run on Spark for each selected case.
conditional_pair_design.arm_order: Alternate C-first and T-first by selected-cohort position, fixed when the six IDs are recorded.
conditional_pair_design.primary_endpoint: Paired EnvBench Official Pass for each arm's final submitted program.
conditional_pair_design.mechanism_endpoint: A treatment first replay semantically fails, its feedback arrives before session end, a later complete program changes in response, and the final treatment program Official-passes.
conditional_pair_design.primary_contrast: T-exclusive Official wins versus C-exclusive Official wins, with both-pass and both-fail reported as ties.
secondary_metrics: input, cached input, output, and reasoning tokens

decision_rule.promote: At least two valid treatment-exclusive supporting causal chains in non-equivalent failure families, more T-exclusive than C-exclusive Official wins, and no replay/Official fidelity contradiction.
decision_rule.retain: One valid treatment-exclusive supporting causal chain, or multiple supporting chains confined to one failure family. Do not open protected evaluation.
decision_rule.kill: After all six valid pairs, T-exclusive wins do not exceed C-exclusive wins and no supporting causal chain exists, or faithful replay systematically increases terminal failures without compensating Official gains.
decision_rule.insufficient: Fewer than six eligible screening failures, fewer than six valid pairs because of nonreplaceable censoring, or fewer than two treatment activations without satisfying the kill rule.

safeguard_note: This file records sampling and analysis decisions; it adds no runtime hash, frozen contract, or gate. Existing safety measures are unchanged.
